recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-12588 unless the work group later decides to make the regexes normative or change the generated regex literals themselves.
issue_request: FHIR-12588 was a Published FHIR-core datatypes change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that primitive datatype regexes account for full-string anchoring. The final resolution was to add a documentation note.
initial_application: The Jira comments say svn @11056 added the Primitive Types note. Git-svn commit d142af1ffbabbd530f4804e65e3556a022ee9d32 carries build@11056 and added the note that regexes should be qualified with start-of-string and end-of-string anchors.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps the default datatype page to datatypes, so source/datatypes.html is build-scoped for primitive datatype documentation. The current source retains the anchor guidance inside the primitive regex notes, and later commit 887bc2383fb only refreshed punctuation/examples. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current datatypes page already says the regexes are informative and should be qualified with start and end anchors based on the regex implementation used.
